source: Conventional-commit shape used throughout the incident-capture work — feature commit citing one or more BR/§ refs in the subject line.

input.commit_message:
feat(incidents): add foundation TypeScript types (§D3, §5)

First slice-0 file. Matches design §D3 verbatim. File is intentionally
imported nowhere per T-01's Verify line; downstream tasks will exercise
these types via their own consumers' tests.

Cites: T-01, §D3, §5

notes: Canonical happy-path: a feature commit citing both spec sections (§5) and design sections (§D3) plus a task ref (T-01). All three citation forms appear; all must be extracted. If the linter ever stops extracting any of these, this case catches it.
